title: Report: Bears S Coby Bryant will miss 8-12 weeks with knee injury

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Report: Bears S Coby Bryant will miss 8-12 weeks with knee injury
sources.description: Bears safety Coby Bryant, who was carted off from practice Monday, was diagnosed with a hyperextended left knee, bone bruise and small fracture, Adam Schefter of ESPN reports.
